value.en: Franz I became reigning Prince of Liechtenstein at 76, after Johann II died on 11 February 1929. On 30 March 1938 he made heir Franz Josef his deputy in exercising all princely rights, while formally remaining prince until his death.

value.zh-Hant: 本略赫·伊·比沃是天主教神職人員，1906至1919年任烏赫爾主教，並因此兼任安道爾共治親王，其間推動通往安道爾城的道路等公共工程。之後他轉任布爾戈斯總主教（1919–1926），並於1921年獲擢升為樞機。
value.en: A Catholic prelate, he was Bishop of Urgell from 1906 to 1919 and in that role Co-Prince of Andorra, promoting public works such as the road to Andorra la Vella. He then became Archbishop of Burgos (1919–1926) and was made a cardinal in 1921.
